events.title: 'As humans we feel spiritually homeless': Turkish author Ece Temelkuran on belonging
events.description: For Ece Temelkuran, the human condition is "unhomed". Speaking to FRANCE 24, the Turkish author cites the rise of artificial intelligence, climate change and the authoritarian drift as reasons why one may no longer recognise the place one calls home. This feeling of "spiritual homelessness" is something she explores in her latest book, "Nation of Strangers: Rebuilding Home in the 21st Century". Most of all, she highlights the importance of human connection: "In survival mode (...) you live on the kindness of others."
